Sent: Thursday, November 7, 2024 4:57 PM
To: Burgess, James
Subject: Revised Master Agreement

Har,

At long last, attached please find the revised agreement, in redline and in final. My instructions were to prepare execution copies, have them signed on behalf of the various Magellan Capital entities, and they are being hand delivered to Mr. Joshua in your credit group for execution on behalf of the various Cedar Point Capital Partners entities. I also prepared guaranty agreements from Magellan Capital Holdings and from Cedar Point Capital Partners, each of which has been either executed or acknowledged on behalf of Magellan Capital. The decision upstairs was that this final version was "take it or leave it" for Cedar Point Capital Partners.

A summary of the major changes:

1. All margining language and references to Collateral were removed.
2. All operating funds were included.
3. The "Group" payment concept was eliminated in Section 4 because it was not clear who would actually be making the payment.

Thanks.

Oscar
